channel_repair.issue: CNS heartbeat monitor stopped at 2026-08-07 23:53 UTC after 310,439 error lines
channel_repair.root_cause: Four packets (seq 32, 50, 077, 136) had malformed JSON (unescaped characters). The monitor polled every 2 seconds, hitting the same broken files in an infinite error loop until it crashed or was stopped.
channel_repair.fix_applied: Quarantined all 4 broken packets to cns_inbox/quarantine/. Packets 159 and 160 are valid JSON and ready for consumption when the monitor restarts.
channel_repair.recommendation: The monitor script needs: (1) a sleep between polls, (2) a max-retry counter that moves broken files aside automatically, (3) a systemd/Windows Task Scheduler restart on crash
